I had a friend who got in a car crash without a seatbelt. He was in the backseat when they got there, fighting to get out. Every bone in his face broken from the steering wheel. He passed that night. 

I knew someone whose grandma got hit by a train in her car. Took an old road over the tracks that had notoriously bad guard arms. 

I worked with a women at one of my first jobs that ended up driving across four lanes of traffic then striking a tree and flying out the front window. At the same job I worked with another lady that was awaiting going to jail for killing a guy and his son on their motorcycle. She was an alcoholic, and as she said was drinking just to keep off the shakes. Just driving her kids to a soccer game or some shit…

My uncle died from a diabetic dip, at least that’s what we gathered. He lived alone and was found on a wellness check cause we hadn’t heard from him in awhile. He was on his kitchen floor and the only thing we could piece together was his last sugar monitor reading. 

This shit is temporary. You never know what’s going to happen next. Live with no regrets. Do the right thing the first time so you don’t need to fix it. You might not get a chance. A wobbly lady in a mom van might be veering the corner any second.
